title: Durable resource and integration recovery inventory providers
description: Objective: supply the missing production recovery-window enumeration sources for scheduler resource effects and integration attempts so the recovery coordinator never infers absence from a generic event scan or a fixture. Deliverable: durable resource and integration attempt inventory records/readers bound to project, effect intent, cursor window and current recovery incarnation, plus immutable RecoveryInventoryRegistration fragments or an equally explicit typed bridge the daemon can compose with @moe/runner registrations. MEASURED GAP at HEAD c0c5929: @moe/scheduler exposes ResourceRow transition functions but no durable inventory enumerator/reader; there is no production integration-attempt record or integration inventory surface in scheduler/store/daemon, and store schema/root probes find no resource/integration inventory rows. The runner collector rejects unknown/extra class evidence. Consumer: task-cf7fb147bd1c47698cbd65c9535370aa. NOT in scope: node-side adapters, adoption/quarantine decisions, project embargo, caller-selected current binding, or recovery.complete. Owned paths: focused scheduler/store contracts and daemon-facing adapters selected after re-measurement; do not grow existing >250-line files. Verification: pnpm --filter @moe/scheduler test && pnpm --filter @moe/store test && pnpm --filter @moe/daemon test && pnpm typecheck.
definitionOfDone: A production durable reader enumerates every project-tagged scheduler resource effect in an exact backup-cursor window, including QUARANTINED/non-fenceable states, and binds each row to its effect intent and source proof digest; empty is COMPLETE only with a verifiable negative proof.

A production durable integration-attempt record and reader enumerate every project-tagged integration target/effect in the same window with exact intent/incarnation binding; unmatched, malformed, duplicate, truncated, or unreadable records stay UNKNOWN with stable code and originating layer.

The daemon-facing bridge exposes immutable registration fragments for the resource and integration populations without mutable global registration, caller-provided item lists, or reimplementation of scheduler/store authority.

Persistence/reopen tests prove resource and integration rows survive process/store reopen and are filtered by exact project/cursor/incarnation; refusal tests assert exact stable code and layer and generated class/case sweeps assert non-zero cardinality.
Focused mutation drills alter each production completeness/fenceability comparison and turn the named resource or integration test red.
Fresh pnpm --filter @moe/scheduler test && pnpm --filter @moe/store test && pnpm --filter @moe/daemon test && pnpm typecheck exits 0, with repo-wide foreign red disclosed by owned-path baseline.
taskRails: Do not infer durable inventory from caller-supplied fixtures or by scanning generic events without a typed complete-population contract.
Do not convert restored counters or a caller-selected incarnation into recovery authority; bind to the selected store/anchor current binding.
Missing/unreadable/partial enumeration stays UNKNOWN and preserves the precise upstream code/layer.
If shared schema or wire contracts change, run full regression as required by the global schema rail.
Target <=250 physical lines per production source and split before 400; the cap is per file.
